evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: The benchmark curates GitHub issue discussions into structured records, extracts human discussion artifacts such as problems, solutions, constraints, rationales, and trade-offs, and then prompts models to generate issue-level "thoughts" using retrieved code context and few-shot examples.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: It converts model responses back into the same artifact space and evaluates them against human annotations using complementary metrics for artifact type detection, metadata matching, tag overlap, and semantic summary similarity.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Beyond scoring, this study includes visualization, leaderboard, and baseline tools that make it possible to compare models, prompting strategies, and extraction methods across repositories and issues.
